title: Join our upcoming Knowledge Portal Webinar on March 26th, 2026!
bodyHtml:
? Join our upcoming Knowledge Portal Webinar on Thursday, March 26th, 2026 from 12:00 - 1:00 PM ET.

?️ Noël Burtt and Luka Maisuradze from the Broad Institute will present on "A Statistically Inferred Genomic Evidence Graph: Integrating the Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE) into the Prototype Open Knowledge Network (Proto-OKN)."

?‍? In this session, we will explore how genomic evidence graphs are advancing data integration and discovery across biomedical research. You’ll learn about:

  • The Prototype Open Knowledge Network (Proto-OKN)
  • Why the CFDE Knowledge Center is collaborating with Proto-OKN
  • The knowledge graph being developed and integrated into Proto-OKN
  • Opportunities to ask questions live and engage with the presenters

? This webinar is a great opportunity to gain insight into emerging approaches for connecting large-scale biomedical data ecosystems and accelerating research.

? Register in advance for this webinar
summary: Noël Burtt and Luka Maisuradze from the Broad Institute will present on "A Statistically Inferred Genomic Evidence Graph: Integrating the Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE) into the Prototype Open Knowledge Network (Proto-OKN)."
